name: app.usehourly/usehourly
title: UseHourly
description: Freelancer time tracking for AI assistants: log time, run timers, build client timesheets and sign-off links, manage clients and projects, make invoices.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. MCP clients that support OAuth (Claude, Cursor, Smithery) connect with log in and approve and need no header. For a client that cannot, use Bearer <personal access token> from Account > AI assistants at usehourly.app.

environmentVariables.name: USEHOURLY_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A token from UseHourly > Account > AI assistants (read-only or read and change, with an expiry). The bridge sends it to https://usehourly.app/api/mcp as a Bearer token.
